cards.q: A deed reads simply 'to A,' with no words of limitation. What estate does A take, and why?
cards.qZh: 契据仅写“转让给A”，没有任何限定词。A取得什么地产权？为什么？
cards.a: Fee simple absolute. Modern law presumes a grantor conveys the largest estate she owns; 'and his heirs' is no longer required. FSA is absolute ownership of potentially infinite duration — freely alienable, devisable, and descendible, with no accompanying future interest.
cards.aZh: 完全保有地产权（fee simple absolute）。现代法律推定设立人转让其拥有的最大权益，无需再写'and his heirs'。FSA是潜在无限期的完全所有权，可自由转让、遗赠、继承，且不附带任何未来权益。
cards.explainZh: 普通法把所有权按时间切片：FSA就是整条时间线，最接近中国法的“所有权”概念。'and his heirs'只是限定词（words of limitation），用来描述权益大小，不给继承人任何权利——这是经典陷阱。

cards.q: What language creates a fee simple determinable, and what future interest accompanies it?
cards.qZh: 什么措辞设立可自动终止的限定性完全保有地产权（fee simple determinable）？随附什么未来权益？
cards.a: Durational words: 'so long as,' 'while,' 'during,' 'until.' The estate ends AUTOMATICALLY when the stated event occurs, and title reverts instantly to the grantor, who retains a possibility of reverter. Both the FSD and the possibility of reverter are alienable, devisable, and descendible.
cards.aZh: 时间性措辞：'so long as'（只要）、'while'（在……期间）、'during'、'until'。所述事件发生时地产权自动终止，产权即刻回归设立人；设立人保留复归可能权（possibility of reverter）。两者均可转让、遗赠、继承。
cards.explainZh: 记忆：FSD与possibility of reverter永远成对出现，“自动”是关键词——无需任何人主张。类比附解除条件的所有权：条件成就即自动复归。与下一张卡的FSCS（须主动行使收回权）形成经典对比。

cards.q: O conveys Blackacre 'to A, but if alcohol is ever sold on the land, O shall have a right to re-enter and retake the premises.' A opens a bar. Before O acts, who holds title?
cards.qZh: O将黑亩地转让“给A，但如土地上出售酒类，O有权重新进入并收回土地”。A开了酒吧。在O采取行动之前，产权归谁？
choices: O — title reverted automatically when alcohol was sold
A — a fee simple subject to condition subsequent persists until O exercises the right of entry
A — the condition is void as a restraint on alienation
O's heirs — a right of entry passes only by descent
cards.explain: Conditional words ('but if') plus an express re-entry right create a fee simple subject to condition subsequent: forfeiture is not automatic. The automatic-reversion choice instead describes a fee simple determinable; the condition restricts use, not alienation.
cards.explainZh: 对比记忆：FSD（时间性用语）自动终止；FSCS（'but if / provided that / on condition that'＋收回权）必须由设立人主动行使进入权，行使之前A仍持有产权。「售酒时产权自动复归」一项混淆了FSD；「条件属转让限制而无效」一项错在该条件限制的是使用而非转让权；「归O的继承人」一项错在收回权归O本人持有（多数州可继承，但并非只能由继承人取得）。

cards.q: O conveys 'to A, but if A ever uses the land commercially during A's lifetime, then to B.' What interest does B have?
cards.qZh: O转让“给A，但若A在其有生之年将土地用于商业用途，则归B”。B享有什么权益？
choices: A possibility of reverter
A contingent remainder
A shifting executory interest
A vested remainder subject to divestment
cards.explain: A third party's interest that cuts short a transferee's defeasible fee is a shifting executory interest; remainders never follow a fee. It is valid under RAP because it must vest, if at all, during A's life.
cards.explainZh: 口诀：切断fee的只能是执行权益（executory interest），剩余权永远不能跟在fee后面；剥夺受让人＝shifting，剥夺设立人＝springing。「复归可能权」一项错：归设立人的才是复归可能权。RAP陷阱：本例条件限于A有生之年所以有效；若写成无时限的'只要不作商业用途，否则归B'，B的权益将违反RAP被删除，A剩下FSD、O保留复归可能权——这就是'一般性条件的转赠'陷阱。

cards.q: A life tenant occupies Blackacre. Name the three types of waste and the future-interest holders' rights.
cards.qZh: 终身地产权人占有黑亩地。浪费（waste）分哪三类？未来权益人有何救济？
cards.a: Affirmative (voluntary): deliberate harmful acts, including new mineral exploitation — though 'open mines' may continue. Permissive: neglect — failing ordinary repairs, property taxes, or mortgage interest. Ameliorative: value-increasing alterations; actionable at common law, allowed today if market value is not impaired and conditions have changed. Vested future-interest holders may sue for damages or an injunction.
cards.aZh: 主动浪费：故意损害行为，包括新开采矿产——但既有“已开之矿”可继续。消极浪费：怠于日常维修、缴纳财产税或支付按揭利息。改良性浪费：增值性改建，普通法上仍可诉；现代法在不减损市价且情势已变时允许。享有既得未来权益者可诉请损害赔偿或禁令。
cards.explainZh: 直觉：终身地产权人好比中国法的用益物权人——只能“用”，不能吃掉本体。三类口诀：毁（主动）、懒（消极）、改（改良）。“好心装修也算浪费”是普通法的反直觉考点。终身地产权可按他人生命计算（pur autre vie）：'给A终身，以B的生命为限'，A先死则权益作为其遗产延续至B死亡。

cards.q: At common law, 'to A and the heirs of his body' created a fee tail; today nearly every US state construes such words as creating {{c::a fee simple absolute}}.
cards.qZh: 普通法上，“给A及其直系血亲继承人”设立限嗣继承地产权（fee tail）；如今美国几乎所有州将这类措辞解释为设立____。
cards.a: a fee simple absolute
cards.aZh: 完全保有地产权（fee simple absolute）
cards.explainZh: fee tail旨在让土地在家族血脉内世代相传，现已基本废除。考试见到'and the heirs of his body'直接按FSA处理（个别州按终身地产权处理，MBE不考）。

cards.topicZh: 未来权益与永续禁止规则
cards.q: Name the three future interests retained by a grantor and state whether RAP applies to them.
cards.qZh: 设立人可保留哪三种未来权益？永续禁止规则（RAP）是否适用于它们？
cards.a: (1) Reversion — retained whenever the grantor conveys less than she owns (e.g., only a life estate); (2) possibility of reverter — follows a fee simple determinable; (3) right of entry (power of termination) — follows a fee simple subject to condition subsequent. All three are treated as vested at creation, so RAP never applies.
cards.aZh: (1) 复归权（reversion）：转让的权益小于自己所有时自动保留，如仅设终身地产权；(2) 复归可能权：随FSD；(3) 进入权/终止权：随FSCS。三者在创设时即视为既得权益，故一律不受RAP约束。
cards.explainZh: 记忆：“留在设立人手里的都不怕RAP”。复归权自动产生、无需明示；进入权在部分州不得生前转让（只能继承或随复归权移转）。这是判断RAP适用范围的第一道筛子。

cards.topicZh: 未来权益与永续禁止规则
cards.q: Classify the four kinds of remainders.
cards.qZh: 剩余权（remainder）分哪四类？如何区分？
cards.a: A remainder follows the natural end of a prior estate — never a fee. (1) Indefeasibly vested: ascertained taker, no condition. (2) Vested subject to open: class gift with at least one member vested. (3) Vested subject to divestment: a condition subsequent may defeat it. (4) Contingent: unascertained taker OR condition precedent — and subject to RAP.
cards.aZh: 剩余权衔接前一地产权的自然终止——绝不跟在fee后面。(1) 确定既得：受让人已确定且无条件；(2) 既得但可扩员：集体赠与中至少一人已既得；(3) 既得但可被剥夺：附解除性条件；(4) 或有剩余权：受让人未确定或附生效前提条件——须受RAP检验。
cards.explainZh: 分类决定命运：既得剩余权基本安全，或有剩余权和“可扩员”的既得剩余权要过RAP这一关。判断口诀：先问“人定了吗”，再问“条件是生效前提还是事后剥夺”——写在赠与语句逗号之内的通常是前提条件（contingent），另起一句剥夺的是condition subsequent。

cards.topicZh: 未来权益与永续禁止规则
cards.q: An executory interest that divests another transferee's interest is {{c::shifting}}; one that divests the grantor at a future time is springing.
cards.qZh: 剥夺另一受让人权益的执行权益称为____执行权益；在未来时点剥夺设立人权益的称为springing（跳跃型）执行权益。
cards.a: shifting
cards.aZh: shifting（转移型）
cards.explainZh: shifting＝受让人→受让人（权益在受让人之间“转移”）；springing＝设立人→受让人（从设立人手里“跳出来”，如“待A结婚时归A”）。执行权益全部属于或有权益，必须逐一过RAP。

cards.topicZh: 未来权益与永续禁止规则
cards.q: State the three common-law future-interest doctrines that are mostly abolished today, with their old effects.
cards.qZh: 哪三项普通法未来权益规则如今已基本废除？其原有效果是什么？
cards.a: (1) Destructibility of contingent remainders: one not vested when the prior estate ended was destroyed — now it becomes a springing executory interest. (2) Rule in Shelley's Case: 'to A for life, then to A's heirs' gave A both interests, merging into a fee simple. (3) Worthier Title: a remainder in the grantor's own heirs became a reversion.
cards.aZh: (1) 或有剩余权可毁灭规则：前一地产权终止时尚未既得的或有剩余权即告消灭——现代法改为转化成springing执行权益；(2) Shelley案规则：“给A终身，再给A的继承人”使A同时取得两个权益并合并为完全保有；(3) 更尊贵产权原则：给设立人自己继承人的剩余权视为设立人保留复归权。三者均已基本废除。
cards.explainZh: 现代考法：三条都按“废除后”处理——或有剩余权不再毁灭、A的继承人保留或有剩余权、O的继承人也保留或有剩余权。见到这三种句式，先报旧规则再答现代结论，稳拿分。

cards.topicZh: 未来权益与永续禁止规则
cards.q: Under the rule of convenience, a class gift closes when {{c::any member can demand possession}}; later-born members are excluded, but children in gestation are included.
cards.qZh: 根据便利规则（rule of convenience），集体赠与的成员范围在____时即告封闭；此后出生者被排除，但已在母腹中者计入。
cards.a: any member can demand possession
cards.aZh: 任何一名成员有权要求占有（分配）
cards.explainZh: 这是解释规则，目的是避免无休止等待并挽救很多本会违反RAP的赠与。例：“给A终身，再给B的子女”——A死亡时只要B已有子女，集体即封闭，B之后再生的孩子不算。封闭时集体中无人的例外：等待全部成员出生。

cards.topicZh: 未来权益与永续禁止规则
cards.q: State the common-law Rule Against Perpetuities, the interests it governs, and the validating-life method.
cards.qZh: 陈述普通法永续禁止规则（RAP）、其适用的权益类型及“验证生命”分析法。
cards.a: No interest is good unless it must vest, if at all, within 21 years of a life in being at creation. Governs contingent remainders, executory interests, vested remainders subject to open, and common-law options and rights of first refusal — never grantor interests. Valid if ANY person alive at creation proves vesting or failure within that life plus 21 years.
cards.aZh: 任何权益，除非必定在创设时在世的某人死后21年内确定归属（或确定落空），否则无效。适用于：或有剩余权、执行权益、可扩员的既得剩余权，以及（普通法上）购买选择权与优先购买权——绝不适用于设立人保留的权益。只要能找到一个创设时在世的“验证生命”，以其生命加21年即可证明归属必然确定，权益即有效。
cards.explainZh: 中国法没有对应制度——目的是防止“死手”永久控制财产。操作三步：①找出可疑权益；②定创设时点（契据＝交付时，遗嘱＝立遗嘱人死亡时）；③设想最坏情形：能否有人在所有在世生命死后21年才取得？想得出一种可能→整个权益作废（普通法只看可能性，不看实际结果）。

cards.topicZh: 未来权益与永续禁止规则
cards.q: T's will devises 'to A for life, then to A's children for life, then to A's grandchildren in fee.' At T's death A is 80, with two adult children and one grandchild. The gift to A's grandchildren is:
cards.qZh: T的遗嘱：“给A终身，再给A的子女终身，最后给A的孙辈完全保有。”T死亡时A已80岁，有两名成年子女和一名孙辈。给A孙辈的赠与效力如何？
choices: Valid — an 80-year-old is conclusively past childbearing
Valid — the living grandchild is a validating life
Void only as to grandchildren born of after-born children
Void entirely — the class gift fails under the all-or-nothing rule
cards.explain: The law conclusively presumes A could have another child, who would not be a life in being; that child's children could vest more than 21 years after all measuring lives end. A class gift void as to any possible member is void for all members.
cards.explainZh: “可生育推定”不可反驳——80岁也可能再生育（收养同理）。新生子女不是创设时在世生命，其子女（孙辈）可能在所有验证生命死后21年才出生并加入集体，故过不了RAP；而集体赠与“一损俱损”（all-or-nothing），已出生的孙辈也被拖下水。「80岁必不能再生育」与「在世孙辈可作验证生命」两项都试图引入例外，普通法不认；「仅对后出生子女所生的孙辈无效」一项描述的是改革法（如wait-and-see）下才可能的结果。

cards.topicZh: 未来权益与永续禁止规则
cards.q: T devises Blackacre 'to my son A for life, then to A's widow for life, then to A's issue then living.' Under the common-law RAP, which interest fails?
cards.qZh: T遗赠黑亩地“给吾儿A终身，再给A的遗孀终身，最后给彼时在世的A的后裔”。依普通法RAP，哪个权益无效？
choices: The remainder to A's issue then living
The widow's life estate
Both the widow's and the issue's interests
Neither — A is a validating life for all interests
cards.explain: A's widow is identified at A's death, so her interest vests in time (A is the validating life) — but she might be someone born after T's death who lives beyond every measuring life plus 21 years, so the issue's survival-contingent remainder may vest too remotely.
cards.explainZh: 陷阱：“遗孀”是身份而非具体人，可能是T死后才出生的女子，她可以在所有验证生命死后21年仍然在世，届时才能确定“彼时在世的后裔”→太迟，无效。遗孀本人的权益在A死亡时即确定（A是验证生命）→有效，故「遗孀与后裔的权益均无效」一项错。同族陷阱：怠惰遗嘱执行人（“遗产管理完毕时分配”——管理可能拖过21年，赠与无效）。

cards.topicZh: 未来权益与永续禁止规则
cards.q: Developer grants Investor 'an option to purchase Greenacre, exercisable by Investor, her heirs, or assigns at any time.' Under the common-law RAP, the option is:
cards.qZh: 开发商授予投资人“可由其本人、继承人或受让人随时行使的购买绿亩地选择权”。依普通法RAP，该选择权：
choices: Valid — options are never subject to RAP
Void — it could be exercised beyond all lives in being plus 21 years
Valid if promptly recorded
Valid under the charity-to-charity exception
cards.explain: An option 'in gross' unlimited in time violates the common-law RAP; only an option appurtenant to a current leasehold, exercisable within the lease term, escapes. Recording is irrelevant, and the charity exception requires a gift over from one charity to another.
cards.explainZh: 无时限的独立购买选择权（option in gross）和优先购买权在普通法上受RAP约束→无效；租户在租期内行使的购买选择权除外。慈善例外仅限“慈善转慈善”（两头都是慈善组织）。注意改革：USRAP（含加州）把非赠与性的商业交易整体排除出RAP，此类选择权改受合理期限规则约束——所以加州论文题要分层作答。
cards.caNote: CA adopted USRAP: commercial (nondonative) options are excluded from RAP entirely; donative interests get a 90-year wait-and-see period.
cards.caNoteZh: 加州采纳USRAP：商业性（非赠与）选择权完全不适用RAP；赠与性权益适用90年“观望期”。

cards.topicZh: 未来权益与永续禁止规则
cards.q: Name the three modern RAP reforms and California's rule.
cards.qZh: 现代对RAP的三种改革是什么？加州采用哪种？
cards.a: (1) Wait-and-see: validity judged by events as they actually unfold; (2) cy pres: courts reform the grant to approximate intent within the Rule (age 25 becomes 21); (3) USRAP: valid if it satisfies the common-law Rule OR actually vests within 90 years. California adopted USRAP; nondonative commercial transfers are exempt.
cards.aZh: (1) 观望规则（wait-and-see)：按实际发生的事件判断效力，不再看“任何可能”；(2) 近似原则（cy pres)：法院改写条款使其在规则内尽量接近设立人本意（如“25岁取得”改为“21岁”）；(3) USRAP：符合普通法规则或实际在90年内归属即有效。加州采USRAP；非赠与性商业交易豁免。
cards.explainZh: 答题顺序：先用普通法RAP分析（MBE默认），加州题再补一句“即便普通法下无效，USRAP允许等90年看实际归属”。三种改革共同点：把“看可能性杀权益”改成“看现实救权益”。
cards.caNote: California Probate Code §§21200–21231 (USRAP): 90-year wait-and-see alternative; commercial transactions excluded.
cards.caNoteZh: 加州《遗嘱认证法典》§§21200–21231（USRAP）：90年观望期作为替代验证途径；商业交易排除适用。

cards.q: What is required to create a joint tenancy, and what is the default cotenancy?
cards.qZh: 设立联权共有（joint tenancy）需要什么条件？默认的共有形式是什么？
cards.a: Four unities (TTIP): Time, Title (same instrument), Interest (equal shares), Possession (equal right to the whole) — plus clear survivorship language, e.g., 'as joint tenants with right of survivorship.' Absent that, the default is tenancy in common. On a joint tenant's death the survivors take automatically; nothing passes by will or probate.
cards.aZh: 四个统一性（TTIP）：同时取得（Time）、同一文件（Title）、份额均等（Interest）、平等占有整体（Possession），并须明确表达生存者取得权，如'as joint tenants with right of survivorship'。未明示则默认为分权共有（TIC）。联权共有人死亡时其权益自动归于生存者，不经遗嘱或遗产程序。
cards.explainZh: 类比：JT≈共同共有＋“生存者自动全取”；TIC≈按份共有（份额可不等、可自由转让、可继承）。与中国法的关键区别：JT死者的权益不是被继承，而是当然消灭、由生存共有人吸收——遗嘱也改变不了。
cards.caNote: California presumes tenancy in common; a joint tenancy must be expressly declared in the instrument (Civ. Code §683).
cards.caNoteZh: 加州推定为分权共有；联权共有必须在文件中明示设立（《民法典》§683）。

cards.q: How is a joint tenancy severed — by conveyance, mortgage, lease, or will?
cards.qZh: 联权共有如何被切断——转让、抵押、出租、遗嘱各有什么效果？
cards.a: Inter vivos conveyance of a joint tenant's interest severs it as to that share — unilateral, secret, no consent or notice required. Mortgage: lien-theory majority (and California) — no severance; title-theory minority — severs. Lease: courts split; many find no severance. Will: never severs — survivorship operates at the instant of death, so the devise fails.
cards.aZh: 生前转让自己的份额即切断该份额的联权共有——可单方、甚至秘密进行，无需同意或通知。抵押：留置权理论（多数州及加州）不切断；产权理论（少数州）切断。出租：法院分歧，多数认为不切断。遗嘱：绝不切断——死亡瞬间生存者取得权已生效，遗赠落空。
cards.explainZh: 高频考点：①转给稻草人或（依加州成文法）直接转给自己也能切断；②“我把份额遗赠给X”无效——survivorship快过遗嘱；③抵押是否切断取决于州理论，埋下rp024的伏笔（留置权理论州：抵押人先死，抵押随之消灭）。
cards.caNote: CA follows lien theory: one joint tenant's mortgage or deed of trust does not sever. A unilateral severance deed generally must be recorded to defeat an innocent surviving joint tenant (Civ. Code §683.2).
cards.caNoteZh: 加州采留置权理论：单个共有人设定抵押/信托契据不切断联权共有。单方切断契据一般须登记，方能对抗不知情的生存共有人（《民法典》§683.2）。

cards.q: A, B, and C hold Blackacre as joint tenants. A conveys her one-third to D. Who owns Blackacre, and how?
cards.qZh: A、B、C以联权共有持有黑亩地。A将其三分之一转让给D。现在产权状况如何？
choices: D, B, and C are all tenants in common
D, B, and C are all joint tenants
D holds one-third as tenant in common; B and C remain joint tenants as to two-thirds
The conveyance is void without B's and C's consent
cards.explain: Severance operates only on the conveyed share: D lacks unity of time and title with B and C, but B's and C's unities with each other remain intact. No cotenant consent is required to transfer one's own share.
cards.explainZh: 切断只及于转让的份额：D与B、C之间四统一性被打破→按份共有；B与C之间原有统一性未受影响→彼此仍是联权共有。若B随后死亡，C自动吸收B的份额（合计2/3），再与D按份共有。「三人均为按份共有」一项过度切断；「未经B、C同意转让无效」一项错在联权共有人可自由处分自己的份额。

cards.q: Describe tenancy by the entirety and California's position.
cards.qZh: 何为夫妻整体共有（tenancy by the entirety）？加州立场如何？
cards.a: A cotenancy for married couples only (about half the states), with survivorship. Neither spouse can unilaterally sever, convey, or encumber it, and creditors of one spouse alone cannot reach the property. Divorce converts it to a tenancy in common. California does not recognize it — community property, optionally with right of survivorship, serves instead.
cards.aZh: 仅限已婚夫妻的共有形式（约半数州承认），附生存者取得权。任何一方均不得单方切断、转让或设定负担；仅一方的债权人不能执行该财产。离婚后转为分权共有。加州不承认此制度——由夫妻共同财产制（可附生存者取得权）替代。
cards.explainZh: TBE≈“加锁版”JT：单方动不了，一方的债权人也碰不得——对比JT可单方切断。加州考题出现夫妻共有，用community property框架分析。中国法类比：夫妻共同财产（共同共有），但中国法没有生存者自动全取机制。
cards.caNote: No TBE in California. 'Community property with right of survivorship' (Civ. Code §682.1) replicates the survivorship feature, with a double stepped-up basis tax advantage.
cards.caNoteZh: 加州无TBE。“附生存者取得权的共同财产”（《民法典》§682.1）实现相同的生存者取得功能，且有双重递增计税基础的税务优势。

cards.q: Each cotenant may possess the entire property; one in sole possession owes rent to the others only upon {{c::ouster}} — refusing a cotenant's demand to share possession — or by agreement.
cards.qZh: 每名共有人都有权占有全部不动产；独自占有者仅在____（拒绝其他共有人提出的共同占有要求）或另有约定时，才须向其他共有人支付租金。
cards.a: ouster
cards.aZh: 排除占有（ouster）
cards.explainZh: 占有整体是每个共有人的固有权利，所以“你住我没住”本身不欠租。ouster的意义双重：①独占者自此对其他共有人负租金责任；②时效取得的时钟自此起算——共有人之间没有ouster就永远谈不上“敌意”占有。

cards.q: Between cotenants, who bears taxes, mortgage payments, repairs, and improvements, and who shares rents collected from third parties?
cards.qZh: 共有人之间如何分担税款、按揭还款、维修与改良费用？向第三人收取的租金如何处理？
cards.a: Third-party rents: the collecting cotenant accounts pro rata for net rents. Taxes and mortgage: contribution required, but a sole possessor recovers only amounts exceeding fair rental value. Necessary repairs: no direct contribution action (majority) — credited in an accounting or partition. Improvements: no contribution; the improver takes the added value (or loss) at partition.
cards.aZh: 第三人租金：收取者须就净租金按份额向其他共有人结算。税款与按揭：可要求分摊，但独自占有者仅能就超出合理租值的部分求偿。必要维修：多数州不能直接诉请分摊——在结算或分割时抵扣。改良：不得要求分摊；分割时增值（或贬值）归改良者承受。
cards.explainZh: 口诀：“租金要分、税贷可摊、修理记账、改良自负”。与《民法典》第302－304条按份共有的管理费用分担思路相近，但美国法把维修、改良推迟到分割时算总账是特色考点。

cards.q: Any tenant in common or joint tenant has an absolute right to partition; courts prefer partition {{c::in kind}}, ordering sale only when physical division is impracticable or would prejudice the parties.
cards.qZh: 任何分权或联权共有人都享有请求分割的绝对权利；法院优先采用____，仅在实物分割不可行或将损害各方利益时才判令变卖分割。
cards.a: in kind
cards.aZh: 实物分割（partition in kind）
cards.explainZh: 与《民法典》第303条“能实物分割的实物分割”思路一致。TBE在婚姻存续期间不可请求分割。共有人可以约定合理期限内不分割（有效）。变卖分割时，垫付的税贷、维修与改良增值在价款中统一结算。

cards.q: A and B own Blackacre as joint tenants in a lien-theory state. A alone mortgages her interest to Bank, then dies. What does B own?
cards.qZh: A、B在留置权理论州以联权共有持有黑亩地。A单独将其权益抵押给银行，随后死亡。B取得什么？
choices: The whole property, free of Bank's mortgage
The whole property, subject to a mortgage on an undivided half
Only a half interest — the mortgage severed the joint tenancy
Nothing until Bank forecloses
cards.explain: In lien theory a mortgage does not sever the joint tenancy (Harms v. Sprague); A's interest — and the lien that attached only to it — is extinguished at her death, so the survivor takes the whole unencumbered. Lenders must get every joint tenant's signature.
cards.explainZh: 留置权理论下抵押只是“贴”在A的权益上，不切断JT；A一死，其权益因生存者取得权当然消灭，皮之不存毛将焉附——银行的抵押同归于尽（Harms诉Sprague案）。加州同此规则。反之在产权理论州抵押即切断，结果就是「抵押切断联权共有、仅取得一半权益」一项。教训：银行放贷必须让全体联权共有人签字。
cards.caNote: California follows lien theory — same result: the surviving joint tenant takes free of the deceased cotenant's unilateral encumbrance.
cards.caNoteZh: 加州采留置权理论——结果相同：生存共有人取得全部产权，不受已故共有人单方设定负担的约束。

cards.q: Name the four leasehold estates and how each ends.
cards.qZh: 四种租赁地产权是什么？各自如何终止？
cards.a: (1) Term of years: any fixed period; ends automatically, no notice (writing if over one year). (2) Periodic: repeats until proper advance notice. (3) At will: either party may end anytime; also ends on death or conveyance. (4) At sufferance: a holdover's bare possession until the landlord evicts or elects a new periodic tenancy.
cards.aZh: (1) 定期租赁：起止确定的任何固定期限，届满自动终止、无需通知（超过一年须书面）；(2) 周期性租赁：自动续期，直至一方提前发出合规通知；(3) 任意租赁：任一方随时可终止，一方死亡或转让土地亦终止；(4) 容忍租赁：逾期滞留者的单纯占有，持续至房东驱逐或选择成立新的周期性租赁。
cards.explainZh: term of years名字骗人——3个月也算，重点是起止日确定。周期性租赁常由行为默示成立（无定期约定但按月付租）。容忍租赁不是真正的权益，只是给逾期者贴的标签，去向由房东单方决定（见rp027）。

cards.q: T rents month-to-month, rent due the 1st. On June 15 T gives written notice terminating 'July 15.' At common law, when does the tenancy end?
cards.qZh: T按月租房，每月1日付租。6月15日T书面通知“7月15日退租”。依普通法，租赁何时终止？
choices: July 15
June 30
July 1
July 31
cards.explain: Common law requires notice of at least one full period, effective only on the final day of a period. Notice given June 15 cannot reach June 30 (less than a month), so the earliest valid endpoint is July 31; most courts give the defective notice effect then.
cards.explainZh: 两个要求缺一不可：①提前至少一个完整周期；②只能在周期最后一天生效。6月15日的通知赶不上6月30日（不足一个月），顺延至7月31日生效。年续年租赁的普通法通知期为6个月。加州已软化规则：通知可在任意日期生效，见caNote。
cards.caNote: CA: tenant gives 30 days' notice effective any day; a landlord must give 60 days if the tenant has resided 12+ months, and AB 1482 adds just-cause eviction limits.
cards.caNoteZh: 加州：租客提前30天通知、可在任意日期生效；租客居住满12个月的，房东须提前60天，并受AB 1482“正当理由”驱逐限制。

cards.q: T's lease expires but T remains in possession. What are the landlord's options and the new tenancy's terms?
cards.qZh: 租期届满T仍占有房屋。房东有哪些选择？新租赁的条款如何确定？
cards.a: The landlord may (1) evict the holdover as a tenant at sufferance and recover damages, or (2) bind T to a new periodic tenancy on the old terms. Majority: the period equals the rent-computation interval — residential usually month-to-month; commercial leases with annual rent, year-to-year in many states. A rent increase announced before expiration binds a holdover.
cards.aZh: 房东可以：(1) 将滞留者按容忍租赁驱逐并索赔占用损害；或 (2) 单方选择按原条款成立新的周期性租赁。多数规则：周期按原租约租金的计算单位确定——住宅通常按月；按年计租的商业租约在许多州按年。房东在届满前已通知涨租的，滞留视为默认接受新租金。
cards.explainZh: 关键：选择权全在房东，租客多赖一天就可能被套牢一个周期。豁免：滞留仅数小时或非租客所能控制（如重病）不适用。对比《民法典》第734条：中国续租推定为不定期租赁、随时可解——美国法更严厉，直接续满一个周期并可适用涨价后的租金。

cards.q: T abandons the premises mid-term without justification. What are the landlord's options, and California's rule?
cards.qZh: T无正当理由中途弃租。房东有哪些选择？加州规则如何？
cards.a: Abandonment is an implied offer of surrender. Landlord may (1) accept surrender — T's future rent liability ends; (2) relet on T's account, holding T for any deficiency; or (3) at common law, leave vacant and sue rent as it accrues — but California and the modern trend abolish option 3: the landlord must reasonably mitigate.
cards.aZh: 弃租构成默示的“交还要约”。房东可：(1) 接受交还——租客此后的租金责任终止；(2) 代租客转租，向其追偿差额；(3) 普通法允许空置房屋、按期追索租金——但加州及现代趋势废除第(3)项：房东必须合理努力减损（另行招租），可避免的损失不得索赔。
cards.explainZh: 与《民法典》第591条减损义务同理——加州把租约当普通合同处理。答题模板：先列三个选项，再看法域：加州删掉“坐等收租”。押金规则顺带记：21天内分项清单并退还、上限一般为一个月租金。
cards.caNote: CA Civ. Code §1951.2: landlord must mitigate on abandonment. Security deposits: itemized statement and refund within 21 days (§1950.5); deposits now generally capped at one month's rent.
cards.caNoteZh: 加州《民法典》§1951.2：弃租后房东必须减损。押金：21天内提供分项清单并退还（§1950.5）；现一般不得超过一个月租金。

cards.q: Landlord ignores T's repeated complaints about nightly sewage backups in T's apartment. T remains eight months, then sues to end the lease, claiming constructive eviction. Result?
cards.qZh: 房东无视T多次投诉公寓夜间污水倒灌。T继续居住八个月后起诉解除租约，主张推定驱逐。结果如何？
choices: T wins — the interference was substantial
T loses — T failed to vacate within a reasonable time
T loses — sewage problems are not the landlord's responsibility
T wins — the implied warranty of habitability terminates the lease automatically
cards.explain: Constructive eviction requires Substantial interference, Notice to the landlord, and Getting out within a reasonable time; staying eight months defeats the claim. Habitability is a separate theory that lets the tenant remain — but it never terminates a lease automatically.
cards.explainZh: SING口诀：Substantial interference＋Notice＋Get out——必须及时搬走，赖着住就不是“被驱逐”。「干扰重大故T胜」一项只看了第一要件；「污水问题非房东之责」一项错，重大缺陷属房东违反安静享有默示义务；「居住性默示担保自动终止租约」一项错在IWH虽允许不搬，但救济是修抵、减租或损害赔偿，不会自动解除租约。策略：想留下用IWH，想走人用推定驱逐。
cards.mnemonic: SING: Substantial interference, Notice, Get out

cards.q: State the majority rule on delivery of possession, and the rent consequences of actual, partial, and paramount-title evictions.
cards.qZh: 交付占有的多数规则是什么？实际驱逐、部分驱逐、优越产权驱逐各自对租金有何影响？
cards.a: English (majority) rule: the landlord must deliver legal AND actual possession at the term's start — a holdover prior tenant is the landlord's breach (American minority: legal right only). Total actual eviction ends rent liability. Partial eviction by the landlord: rent is wholly abated. Partial eviction by one with paramount title: rent abates pro rata.
cards.aZh: 英国规则（多数）：租期开始时房东须交付法律上及实际的占有——前手租客滞留即属房东违约（美国少数规则：仅须法律上的权利）。全部实际驱逐：租金义务终止。房东所为的部分驱逐：租金全部免除。因优越产权人所为的部分驱逐：按比例减租。
cards.explainZh: 记忆点：房东自己占了你一间房，一分租金都收不到——“逐我一寸、免租全部”是惩罚性规则；第三人凭优越产权占去一部分，只按比例减。安静享有默示担保贯穿所有租约（住宅＋商业），推定驱逐即由它派生。

cards.q: Scope and remedies of the implied warranty of habitability?
cards.qZh: 适居性默示担保（IWH）的适用范围与救济手段？
cards.a: Residential leases only (majority); standard: premises fit for basic human habitation — housing codes are evidence. It cannot be waived. After notice and a reasonable time to repair, the tenant may: Move out and terminate; Repair and deduct; Reduce or withhold rent (often paid into escrow); or Remain and sue damages. Unlike constructive eviction, the tenant need not vacate.
cards.aZh: 仅适用于住宅租赁（多数州）；标准：适于基本人类居住——住房法规是证据。不得以约定排除。通知房东并给予合理修缮期后，租客可：搬离并解约；自行维修并从租金中扣除；减付或暂扣租金（常须存入提存账户）；或留住并诉请损害赔偿。与推定驱逐不同，无须搬离。
cards.explainZh: IWH是租客最强武器：不用搬家就有全套救济，且“租客承诺自行维修”条款不能免除房东义务。加州由Green案确立：修抵以一个月租金为限、一年两次。普通法“租约各项义务相互独立”原则在此被打破——租金义务与适居性直接挂钩。
cards.mnemonic: MR3: Move, Repair & deduct, Reduce rent, Remain & sue

cards.q: A landlord may not evict, raise rent, or cut services because a tenant reported housing-code violations; adverse action within the statutory window (often 90–180 days) is presumed {{c::retaliatory}}.
cards.qZh: 租客善意举报违反住房法规后，房东不得因此驱逐、涨租或削减服务；在法定期间（通常90至180天）内的不利行为被推定为____。
cards.a: retaliatory
cards.aZh: 报复性的（retaliatory eviction，报复性驱逐）
cards.explainZh: 立法目的：没有反报复保护，IWH等租客权利形同虚设。推定可由房东以正当理由推翻（如租客确实欠租）。加州窗口期为180天，报复既是驱逐之诉的抗辩、也可另诉赔偿。
cards.caNote: CA Civ. Code §1942.5: 180-day presumption; retaliation is a defense to unlawful detainer and supports an affirmative damages action.
cards.caNoteZh: 加州《民法典》§1942.5：180天推定期；报复既是非法滞留驱逐之诉的抗辩，也可提起独立的损害赔偿之诉。

cards.q: L leases to T for five years. T assigns to T1; T1 assigns to T2, who defaults on rent. Absent any assumption agreements, whom may L sue for the rent?
cards.qZh: L租给T五年。T将租约转让给T1，T1再转让给T2，T2拖欠租金。无任何承担协议时，L可就租金起诉谁？
choices: T2 only
T1 and T2
T and T2
T, T1, and T2
cards.explain: T remains liable in privity of contract — the original promise survives assignment; T2 is liable in privity of estate as the current assignee. T1's privity of estate ended on reassignment, and T1 never assumed the lease, so T1 owes nothing.
cards.explainZh: 双轨责任：合同相对性拴住原租客T直到租期结束；地产相对性只拴住“现任”受让人T2。中间人T1两头都不沾——除非曾书面承担（assume），承担者则终身负责。概念辨析：转让＝让出全部剩余租期；转租（sublease）＝保留任何一段期间，转租客与L既无合同也无地产相对性，L只能追原租客。

cards.q: A lease bars assignment without L's consent but states no standard. May L refuse arbitrarily?
cards.qZh: 租约约定未经L同意不得转让，但未规定同意标准。L可以任意拒绝吗？
cards.a: Traditional majority: yes — consent may be withheld for any reason. Growing minority and California (Kendall v. Ernest Pestana): in commercial leases consent may be withheld only on commercially reasonable grounds. A lease silent on transfer is freely assignable. L waives the clause by knowingly accepting rent from the transferee; an unauthorized transfer is effective but a breach.
cards.aZh: 传统多数规则：可以——任何理由都能拒绝。少数趋势及加州（Kendall诉Ernest Pestana案）：商业租赁中只能基于商业上合理的理由拒绝。租约未作限制的可自由转让。房东明知转让而收取受让人租金即放弃异议权；未经同意的转让仍然有效，但构成违约。
cards.explainZh: Kendall的“合理理由”限于受让人支付能力、经营匹配度等客观因素；个人好恶或借机抬租不算。放弃规则考法：房东收了新租客三个月租金再主张违约→已放弃。禁止转让条款作严格解释：禁转让不禁转租，反之亦然。
cards.caNote: Kendall v. Ernest Pestana (Cal. 1985), codified at Civ. Code §1995.260: a commercial lessor needs a commercially reasonable objection; denial to extract higher rent is improper.
cards.caNoteZh: Kendall案（加州1985），成文化于《民法典》§1995.260：商业出租人须有商业上合理的异议理由；借拒绝同意抬高租金属不正当。

cards.q: When is a landlord liable in tort for injuries on leased premises?
cards.qZh: 房东何时对租赁房屋内的人身伤害承担侵权责任？
cards.a: Common law: no landlord duty, with five exceptions — Common areas; Latent defects known to the landlord and undisclosed (a duty to warn, not repair); Assumed or negligently made repairs; Public-use premises; Short-term furnished dwellings. Modern trend and California: a general duty of reasonable care under all the circumstances.
cards.aZh: 普通法：房东原则上不负侵权责任，五项例外——公共区域；房东明知且未告知的隐蔽缺陷（仅告知义务，非维修义务）；自愿承担或有过失的维修；供公众使用的场所；短期带家具住宅。现代趋势及加州：按全部情况承担一般性合理注意义务。
cards.explainZh: 普通法思路是“交房即免责”（caveat lessee），五例外是补丁；加州Rowland案改采统一过失标准。答题先套CLAPS框架，题干提示现代法域或加州则直接用合理注意分析。
cards.mnemonic: CLAPS: Common areas, Latent defects, Assumed repairs, Public use, Short-term furnished

cards.q: A chattel affixed with intent that it permanently improve the realty becomes a fixture and passes with the land; but a tenant may remove trade fixtures {{c::before the lease term ends}}, repairing any damage caused.
cards.qZh: 以永久改良不动产为意图安装的动产成为附着物（fixture），随土地一并移转；但租客可在____拆走其商业设备（trade fixtures），并修复由此造成的损坏。
cards.a: before the lease term ends
cards.aZh: 租期届满前
cards.explainZh: 附着意图用客观因素判断：固定方式、与房产的适配程度、拆除损坏大小。商业设备例外体现鼓励经商政策，但过期不拆视为赠与房东（不定期租赁则在终止后合理期间内可拆）。类比中国法的“添附”，但美国考点集中在“谁能拆、何时拆”。

cards.q: Distinguish easements appurtenant from easements in gross, including transferability.
cards.qZh: 从属地役权与对人地役权如何区分？可转让性有何不同？
cards.a: Appurtenant: benefits the holder's land — requires dominant and servient estates; it passes automatically with the dominant estate even if unmentioned, and the burden runs with the servient land to takers with notice. In gross: benefits a person, no dominant estate (utility lines, billboards); traditionally personal and nontransferable, but commercial easements in gross are assignable.
cards.aZh: 从属地役权：为持有人的土地服务——须有需役地与供役地；随需役地自动移转（即使契据未提及），负担随供役地约束有通知的受让人。对人地役权：服务于特定人，无需役地（如电力线、广告牌）；传统上属人身性、不可转让，但商业性对人地役权可以转让。
cards.explainZh: 与《民法典》第374、380条地役权（从属于需役地、不得单独转让）几乎一致——那正是appurtenant。中国法没有“对人地役权”类别，理解为“贴在土地上、归特定人的使用权”即可；考点：商业性的（管线、铁路）可转让。归类存疑时推定为从属地役权。

cards.q: List the four ways to create an easement, and the rule on reserving one for a third party.
cards.qZh: 地役权的四种创设方式是什么？为第三人保留地役权的规则如何？
cards.a: PING — Prescription; Implication from prior use; Necessity; Grant. An express grant or reservation must satisfy the Statute of Frauds: a writing signed by the grantor (easements over one year). Majority: an express reservation in favor of a stranger to the deed is void; California (Willard) enforces it where the grantor's intent is clear.
cards.aZh: PING口诀——时效取得（Prescription）、基于先前使用的默示（Implication）、必要性（Necessity）、明示授予（Grant）。明示授予或保留须满足防止欺诈法：设立人签署的书面文件（超过一年的地役权）。多数规则：为契据外第三人保留地役权无效；加州（Willard案）在设立人意图明确时承认其效力。
cards.explainZh: 口头授予的“地役权”不满足书面要求→降级为许可（license，见rp044）。Willard是加州著名少数派立场：卖地时为教会保留停车地役权有效——摒弃普通法“契据外之人”规则。
cards.caNote: Willard v. First Church of Christ, Scientist (Cal. 1972): California enforces a reservation in favor of a third party, rejecting the common-law stranger-to-the-deed rule.
cards.caNoteZh: Willard诉基督科学第一教会案（加州1972）：加州承认为第三人保留的地役权，摒弃普通法“契据外之人”规则。

cards.q: A prescriptive easement requires use that is open and notorious, hostile, and continuous for the statutory period — but unlike adverse possession, {{c::exclusive use is not required}}.
cards.qZh: 时效地役权要求公开显著、敌意且持续使用达法定期间——但与时效取得所有权不同，____。
cards.a: exclusive use is not required
cards.aZh: 不要求排他性使用
cards.explainZh: 你和地主同时都在用那条路，照样能“走出”时效地役权——因为取得的是使用权而非所有权。经允许的使用（permissive）永远不构成敌意，时效不起算。加州期间为5年。
cards.caNote: California: 5-year prescriptive period; property-tax payment is required only if the easement was separately assessed (rare).
cards.caNoteZh: 加州：时效期间5年；仅当该地役权被单独评估课税时才需缴税（极少见）。

cards.q: O owns Lots 1 and 2, using a visible gravel drive across Lot 1 to reach Lot 2's garage. O sells Lot 2 to B; the deed is silent. Lot 2 also fronts a public road. B's best theory to keep using the drive?
cards.qZh: O拥有1、2号地块，一直经1号地块上一条可见的砾石车道到达2号地块的车库。O将2号地块卖给B，契据未提车道。2号地块另临公共道路。B主张继续使用车道的最佳理由？
choices: Easement implied from prior use
Easement by necessity
Prescriptive easement
Irrevocable license
cards.explain: Quasi-easement: common ownership was severed after a use that was apparent, continuous, and reasonably necessary to Lot 2's enjoyment. Necessity fails because the lot is not landlocked (strict necessity); prescription fails because O's use of his own land was never hostile; no expenditure supports estoppel.
cards.explainZh: 默示地役权四件套：①同一所有权被分割；②分割前既有使用（准地役权）；③明显（可见即可，含合理检查可发现的地下管道）且持续；④对需役地的使用合理必要。「必要地役权」一项败在“合理必要”≠“严格必要”——临公路就不算被围困；「时效地役权」一项败在自己用自己的地谈不上敌意；「不可撤销许可」一项无信赖支出。

cards.q: Elements and duration of an easement by necessity?
cards.qZh: 必要性地役权的构成要件与存续期间？
cards.a: (1) Common ownership severed, and (2) strict necessity at the moment of severance — the parcel is landlocked with no legal access. No prior use is required. The servient owner selects a reasonable location. The easement lasts only while the necessity lasts — ending, for example, when a public road later abuts the parcel.
cards.aZh: (1) 原属同一所有人的土地被分割；(2) 分割那一刻即存在严格必要性——地块被围困、无合法通道。无需先前使用。通道的合理位置由供役地所有人选定。仅在必要性存续期间存在——例如日后新修公路毗邻该地块时即消灭。
cards.explainZh: 与默示地役权对照记：necessity不要求先前使用但要“严格”必要；implication要求先前使用但只需“合理”必要。政策：土地不能沦为孤岛。类比《民法典》第291条相邻通行权——中国法用相邻关系解决，美国法用地役权解决。

cards.q: How is an easement's scope determined, and what happens if the holder overuses it?
cards.qZh: 地役权的使用范围如何确定？超范围使用（surcharge）的后果是什么？
cards.a: Scope is set by the grant's terms or, if silent, by the parties' reasonable contemplation — normal, foreseeable development of the dominant estate is allowed. The easement may never be used to benefit a non-dominant parcel (Brown v. Voss). Surcharge is misuse: the servient owner may get an injunction or damages, but the easement is NOT forfeited.
cards.aZh: 范围依授予条款确定；未约定的，依双方可合理预见的用途——允许需役地正常的、可预见的发展。绝不允许用地役权为非需役地服务（Brown诉Voss案）。超范围使用属滥用：供役地所有人可请求禁令或损害赔偿，但地役权本身不因此丧失。
cards.explainZh: Brown v. Voss经典：把路延伸去服务后来买的相邻地块＝滥用（哪怕总负担没有增加）；但法院基于衡平裁量未发禁令、只判1美元名义赔偿——考点记住“滥用≠终止”。

cards.q: Easements terminate by Estoppel, Necessity ending, Destruction, Condemnation, Release, Abandonment, Merger, and Prescription; abandonment requires nonuse plus {{c::a physical act showing intent to abandon}} — mere nonuse never suffices.
cards.qZh: 地役权因禁反言、必要性消失、灭失、征收、书面放弃、抛弃、混同、时效而终止；其中“抛弃”要求停止使用加上____——单纯不使用永远不够。
cards.a: a physical act showing intent to abandon
cards.aZh: 表明抛弃意图的实际行为
cards.explainZh: END CRAMP八种终止方式。抛弃的“实际行为”如：铁路公司拆走铁轨、需役地所有人自筑围墙封死路口。混同：两块地归于一人时地役权消灭，日后再分割也不自动复活。书面放弃（release）须满足防止欺诈法。
cards.mnemonic: END CRAMP: Estoppel, Necessity ends, Destruction, Condemnation, Release, Abandonment, Merger, Prescription

cards.q: A orally permits neighbor B to use a strip of A's land as a driveway. With A watching, B spends $20,000 paving it. Two years later A barricades the strip. B's best claim?
cards.qZh: A口头允许邻居B将A土地上的一条地带用作车道。B在A注视下花2万美元铺设路面。两年后A设障封路。B的最佳主张是什么？
choices: The oral grant created a valid express easement
B has a prescriptive easement
The license was revocable at will, so A wins
The license became irrevocable through estoppel
cards.explain: An oral 'easement' fails the Statute of Frauds and creates only a license — normally revocable at will — but substantial expenditure in reasonable reliance, with the licensor's knowledge, makes it irrevocable (easement by estoppel) for as long as needed to realize the investment. Permissive use defeats prescription.
cards.explainZh: 推理链：口头授予→不满足书面要求→只是许可→原则上随时可撤销→但花大钱信赖＋对方明知＝禁反言，不得撤销（存续至收回投资所需期间）。「口头授予创设了有效明示地役权」一项败在书面要求；「时效地役权」一项败在“permissive”——经允许的使用不是敌意使用。另记：与利益相结合的许可（如买了地上木材附带的进入权）也不可撤销。

cards.q: What is a profit à prendre, and who must maintain an easement?
cards.qZh: 取益权（profit à prendre）是什么？地役权设施由谁维护？
cards.a: A profit is the right to enter another's land and remove natural resources — timber, minerals, fish, gravel. Creation, transfer, scope, and termination follow easement rules. Maintenance: the easement holder has the right and duty to maintain the easement and may enter to repair; the servient owner owes none absent agreement; joint users share costs.
cards.aZh: 取益权：进入他人土地并取走自然资源（木材、矿产、鱼类、砂石）的权利。其创设、转让、范围与终止均适用地役权规则。维护：地役权人为自己的使用既有权利也有义务维护设施，并可进入供役地施工；供役地所有人无维护义务（另有约定除外）；共同使用者按使用比例分摊费用。
cards.explainZh: profit＝地役权＋拿走资源；中国法接近取水、采矿等用益物权的思路。维护考点常反直觉：修路义务在“用路的人”（地役权人），不在地主——供役地所有人只须不妨碍。

cards.topicZh: 不动产契约与衡平地役
cards.q: Elements for the BURDEN of a real covenant to run with the land at law?
cards.qZh: 不动产契约的负担在普通法上随土地移转的要件是什么？
cards.a: (1) Writing; (2) intent to bind successors; (3) touch and concern the land; (4) horizontal privity — the original parties shared some land interest besides the covenant (grantor–grantee, landlord–tenant, mortgagee); (5) strict vertical privity — the successor takes the covenantor's entire estate; (6) notice to the successor. The remedy is money damages.
cards.aZh: (1) 书面；(2) 约束继受人的意图（如写明“及其受让人”）；(3) 与土地有实质关联（touch and concern）；(4) 横向相对性——原约定双方在契约之外另有土地权益关系（买卖、租赁、抵押）；(5) 严格纵向相对性——继受人取得立约人的全部地产权；(6) 继受人有通知。救济为金钱损害赔偿。
cards.explainZh: 中国法没有“随土地转移的合同义务”——最接近的是登记的地役权负担。考试策略：原告要钱→按real covenant六件套审查；要禁令→改走衡平地役（rp048），相对性全免。横向相对性最常挂人：邻居之间单独签的限制协议欠缺横向相对性，负担不能在法律上随地移转（但仍可作为衡平地役强制执行）。
cards.mnemonic: WITHN: Writing, Intent, Touch & concern, Horizontal + vertical privity, Notice

cards.topicZh: 不动产契约与衡平地役
cards.q: Elements for the BENEFIT of a real covenant to run?
cards.qZh: 不动产契约的利益随土地移转的要件是什么？
cards.a: Writing, intent, and touch and concern — plus relaxed vertical privity only: the successor need take some possessory interest carved from the original promisee's estate. Horizontal privity is NOT required for the benefit to run, and notice is irrelevant on the benefit side.
cards.aZh: 书面、意图、与土地实质关联——外加宽松的纵向相对性即可：继受人取得源于原受约人地产权的任何占有性权益即可。利益的移转不要求横向相对性，通知与否在利益一侧也无关紧要。
cards.explainZh: 负担难跑、利益好跑——约束人（burden）要六件套，给好处（benefit）只要四件。做题第一步判断随地跑的是负担还是利益（谁的继受人被告/起诉），别把六要件全堆上去。

cards.topicZh: 不动产契约与衡平地役
cards.q: Elements of an equitable servitude, and how does it differ from a real covenant?
cards.qZh: 衡平地役的构成要件是什么？与不动产契约有何区别？
cards.a: Writing (except implied common schemes), intent, touch and concern, and — for the burden — notice (actual, record, or inquiry). NO privity of any kind is required. Enforced by injunction. Practical rule: a plaintiff seeking damages must satisfy real-covenant elements; a plaintiff seeking an injunction needs only the equitable-servitude elements.
cards.aZh: 书面（默示共同规划例外）、意图、与土地实质关联，以及——就负担而言——通知（实际、登记或推问通知）。完全不需要任何相对性。以禁令强制执行。实务规则：请求损害赔偿的原告须满足不动产契约要件；只请求禁令的原告满足衡平地役要件即可。
cards.explainZh: 同一条限制性条款可以既是real covenant又是equitable servitude——请求的救济决定分析路径。理论基础是Tulk v. Moxhay：知情的买受人受良心约束。真正无通知的BFP不受负担约束。

cards.topicZh: 不动产契约与衡平地役
cards.q: Under the implied-reciprocal-servitude doctrine, a lot conveyed without written restrictions is nonetheless bound if {{c::a common scheme of development}} existed when sales began and the buyer had notice.
cards.qZh: 依默示互惠地役原则，契据中未载书面限制的地块，若销售开始时已存在____且买受人有通知，仍受限制约束。
cards.a: a common scheme of development
cards.aZh: 共同开发规划（common scheme）
cards.explainZh: 证明common scheme的证据：统一的销售地图、宣传材料、绝大多数契据含相同限制。通知可以是推问通知——整个小区清一色住宅的外观即足。加州拒绝纯默示路径：限制必须见于书面（Riley案）；但售前已登记的小区宣言即使个别契据漏引也约束后买者（Citizens案）——见caNote。
cards.caNote: California requires a writing: no servitude is implied from an oral common plan (Riley v. Bear Creek Planning Committee); but a declaration recorded before the sale binds all lots even if later deeds omit it (Citizens for Covenant Compliance v. Anderson).
cards.caNoteZh: 加州要求书面：不承认基于口头共同规划的默示地役（Riley诉Bear Creek规划委员会案）；但售前已登记的宣言约束全部地块，即使其后的契据未援引（Citizens for Covenant Compliance诉Anderson案）。

cards.topicZh: 不动产契约与衡平地役
cards.q: Defenses to enforcement of covenants and equitable servitudes?
cards.qZh: 对抗不动产契约或衡平地役强制执行的抗辩有哪些？
cards.a: Changed conditions: the change must be so pervasive that the restriction's benefit is lost for the ENTIRE restricted area — changes affecting only border lots, or outside the subdivision, never suffice. Also: written release, merger, abandonment through widespread violations, estoppel, laches, unclean hands (plaintiff violates too), and acquiescence in prior violations. Condemnation extinguishes with compensation.
cards.aZh: 情势变更：变化须彻底到整个受限区域的限制利益尽失——仅影响边缘地块或发生在小区之外的变化永远不够。另有：书面解除、混同、因普遍违反而抛弃、禁反言、怠于行使（laches）、不洁之手（原告自己也违反）、对先前违反的默许。征收使其消灭并获补偿。
cards.explainZh: changed conditions是最常考抗辩，几乎总是败诉方的论点——记“全域尽失”标准。“小区外面全变商业区了”救不了最外圈的地块——法院拒绝多米诺骨牌论，否则限制会被逐块蚕食。

cards.topicZh: 不动产契约与衡平地役
cards.q: Developer records a declaration restricting all 50 subdivision lots to residential use, then conveys Lot 7 by a deed omitting it. Buyer, who never searched the records, starts building a store. Neighbors sue to enjoin. Result?
cards.qZh: 开发商登记宣言，限定小区全部50块土地仅作住宅用途，随后以未载限制的契据转让第7号地块。从未检索登记的买受人动工建商铺。邻居诉请禁令。结果？
choices: Buyer wins — his own deed contains no restriction
Neighbors win — the recorded declaration gives record notice, and the equitable servitude is enforced by injunction
Neighbors win damages only — an injunction requires horizontal privity
Buyer wins — only the developer may enforce the restrictions
cards.explain: An equitable servitude needs writing, intent, touch and concern, and notice — no privity; the recorded declaration supplies the writing and record notice, and injunction is the equitable remedy. Lot owners within the scheme are intended beneficiaries entitled to enforce.
cards.explainZh: 登记的宣言＝书面＋登记通知：买受人没去查记录是自己的问题（推定知悉）。禁令走衡平地役路径，不需要任何相对性——「禁令需要横向相对性」一项把real covenant的要件错装到禁令上。小区内其他业主是规划受益人，有权执行（「只有开发商可以执行」一项错）。此结论与加州Citizens案完全一致。

cards.topicZh: 不动产契约与衡平地役
cards.q: Under California's Nahrstedt rule, a use restriction in a recorded common-interest declaration is enforceable unless {{c::unreasonable as to the development as a whole}} — hardship to the individual owner is irrelevant.
cards.qZh: 依加州Nahrstedt规则，已登记的共益开发宣言（CC&Rs）中的使用限制一律可强制执行，除非____——对个别业主造成的困难在所不问。
cards.a: unreasonable as to the development as a whole
cards.aZh: 对整个开发项目而言不合理
cards.explainZh: Nahrstedt诉Lakeside Village案（公寓养猫违禁案）：CC&Rs享有效力推定，挑战者须证明限制对整个小区不合理（违反公共政策、恣意、负担远超收益），而不是“对我不公平”。政策：保护全体业主对既定规则的信赖、减少诉讼。
cards.caNote: Nahrstedt v. Lakeside Village Condominium Assn. (Cal. 1994); the presumption of validity is codified at Civ. Code §5975 (former §1354).
cards.caNoteZh: Nahrstedt诉Lakeside Village公寓业主协会案（加州1994）；效力推定成文化于《民法典》§5975（原§1354）。

cards.q: Elements of adverse possession?
cards.qZh: 时效取得（adverse possession）的构成要件是什么？
cards.a: Actual possession; Exclusive — not shared with the owner or the public; Continuous for the statutory period — seasonal use consistent with the land's nature suffices (Howard v. Kunto); Hostile — without the owner's permission; the majority objective test ignores the possessor's state of mind; Open and notorious — visible enough to put a diligent owner on notice.
cards.aZh: 实际占有；排他——不与所有人或公众共享；持续达法定期间——符合土地性质的季节性使用即可（Howard诉Kunto案）；敌意——未经所有人允许即可，多数州采客观标准、占有人主观想法无关紧要；公开显著——足以让勤勉的所有人察觉。
cards.explainZh: 中国法没有不动产取得时效——这是纯普通法制度：占够年头，所有权直接易主，原所有人请求权消灭。“敌意”最易误解：不是吵架结仇，而是“没打招呼就当自己的用”；经允许的使用永远不起算，除非之后明确翻脸（对所有人否认其权利）。
cards.mnemonic: ECHO + Actual: Exclusive, Continuous, Hostile, Open & notorious — plus Actual possession

cards.q: How do tacking and the owner's disabilities affect adverse possession?
cards.qZh: 占有期间的合并计算（tacking）与所有人的无行为能力如何影响时效取得？
cards.a: Successive adverse possessors may tack their periods if in privity — a voluntary transfer by deed, will, or descent; ouster of the prior possessor breaks the chain. An owner's disability (minority, insanity, imprisonment) tolls the statute only if it existed WHEN the adverse possession began; later-arising or tacked successive disabilities are ignored.
cards.aZh: 先后占有人之间存在相对性——经契据、遗嘱或继承的自愿移转——即可合并计算占有期间；强行赶走前占有人则链条中断。所有人的无行为能力（未成年、精神障碍、服刑）仅在时效开始时已存在的才停止计时；事后发生或接续的障碍一概不计。
cards.explainZh: disability只看起算日那一刻：占有开始时所有人未成年→时效延至其成年后若干年；占有第3年所有人才患精神病→照常计时。tacking双向适用：占有方可以接力，所有权一方移转土地时已跑的时效也继续有效。

cards.q: An adverse possessor who enters under {{c::color of title}} — a facially valid but defective instrument — and actually possesses part of the described tract gains constructive possession of the whole.
cards.qZh: 占有人凭____（表面有效但实有瑕疵的权源文件）进入，并实际占有文件所载地块的一部分，即推定占有整个地块。
cards.a: color of title
cards.aZh: 表见权源（color of title）
cards.explainZh: 有瑕疵的假契据反而放大占有范围——这就是“推定占有”（constructive adverse possession）；无表见权源者只能取得实际占有的部分。前提：文件描述的地块须为一体且属同一所有人。部分州还给凭表见权源的占有人更短的时效期间。

cards.q: In California, D fenced and gardened a strip of her neighbor's lot openly, exclusively, and hostilely for six years but never paid the property taxes levied on it. D sues to quiet title by adverse possession. Result?
cards.qZh: 在加州，D公开、排他、敌意地圈占并耕种邻居地块的一条土地达六年，但从未缴纳该地被课征的财产税。D诉请以时效取得确认产权。结果如何？
choices: D wins — five years of possession suffices
D wins — tax payment is required only for prescriptive easements
D loses — California requires five years' possession AND payment of all taxes levied on the parcel
D loses — adverse possession never applies to boundary strips
cards.explain: California requires all the ordinary elements plus timely payment of all state, county, and municipal taxes levied on the property during the five-year period (CCP §325). Boundary strips are proper subjects of adverse possession; the tax element is what defeats most neighbor-encroachment claims.
cards.explainZh: 加州双要件：占有5年＋缴清这5年间课征的全部税款——大多数邻里越界案就死在税上（税单按登记地块寄给真正的所有人）。「只有时效地役权才要求缴税」一项把规则说反了：单独课税的地役权才需缴税，取得所有权则一律要缴。实务后果：加州的越界者更多改走时效地役权或边界协定路线。
cards.caNote: CCP §325(b): five years' continuous possession plus timely payment of all taxes levied; the claimant must prove payment by certified tax records.
cards.caNoteZh: 《民事诉讼法典》§325(b)：连续占有5年并按期缴纳全部课征税款；主张者须以核证税务记录证明缴税事实。

cards.q: Can title be adversely possessed against the government, and what is the agreed-boundaries doctrine?
cards.qZh: 能否对政府土地主张时效取得？“边界协定”原则是什么？
cards.a: No adverse possession runs against government land — federal, state, or local. Agreed-boundaries doctrine: where the true line is uncertain, the neighbors' agreement (express or implied) plus acceptance or acquiescence for the limitations period fixes the boundary, binding successors. Related estoppel and long-acquiescence doctrines reach similar results.
cards.aZh: 对政府土地（联邦、州、地方）不发生时效取得。边界协定原则：真实界线不确定时，相邻双方的协议（明示或默示）加上达到时效期间的接受或默认即可固定边界，并约束继受人。相关的禁反言与长期默认原则可得出类似结果。
cards.explainZh: 中国法对比：中国无不动产取得时效，且登记具有权利推定效力；美国法连登记在册的产权也能被“占”走（加州还要缴税），但国有土地绝对安全——时效不对抗主权。边界协定是处理围墙纠纷的常用工具，前提是真界线曾经不确定。

cards.q: What does the Statute of Frauds require for a land-sale contract, and what is the part-performance exception?
cards.qZh: 不动产买卖合同的书面要求是什么？部分履行例外如何运作？
cards.a: A writing signed by the party to be charged, containing the essential terms: parties, description of the land, and price. Part performance allows specific enforcement of an oral contract when the buyer proves (majority) two of three acts unequivocally referable to a sale: taking possession, substantial part payment, or making improvements.
cards.aZh: 由被追究一方签署的书面文件，载明核心条款：当事人、土地描述、价款。部分履行例外：买方证明以下三项中的两项（多数规则）且该等行为明确指向买卖关系——取得占有、支付相当部分价款、进行改良——口头合同即可获强制实际履行。
cards.explainZh: 部分履行是衡平救济，只支持实际履行之诉，不支持普通法损害赔偿之诉。“明确指向”标准：这些行为除了“我买下了这块地”没有其他合理解释。对比中国法：合同不以书面为生效要件（登记只涉物权变动）——美国法在合同层面就先设了书面关。

cards.q: What makes title unmarketable, and when must the seller deliver marketable title?
cards.qZh: 什么情形构成产权“不可交易”？卖方须在何时提供可交易产权？
cards.a: Implied in every land contract: title reasonably free from doubt. Unmarketable: title resting on unquieted adverse possession; encumbrances — mortgages, liens, easements, covenants, significant encroachments; existing zoning VIOLATIONS (not zoning itself). Timing: only at closing — the seller may clear a mortgage from the proceeds; installment contracts, at final payment. Buyer must notify and allow cure.
cards.aZh: 每份土地合同都默示：产权须合理地无争议风险。不可交易：依未经确权判决的时效取得而来的产权；各类负担——按揭、留置权、地役权、限制性契约、重大越界建筑；现存的违反区划行为（区划本身不算）。时点：仅在交割时——卖方可用交割价款清偿按揭；分期付款合同则在付清尾款时。买方须通知瑕疵并给予补正时间。
cards.explainZh: 三大陷阱：①交割前买方不能以产权瑕疵为由撤退——卖方到交割那一刻补正即可；②“该区有区划限制”≠不可交易，“现有建筑违反区划”＝不可交易；③本担保在交割时并入契据（merger，见rp065），此后只能依契据担保起诉。

cards.q: After the contract is signed but before closing, the house on Blackacre burns down without either party's fault. The contract is silent on risk. Under the majority rule, who bears the loss?
cards.qZh: 签约后、交割前，黑亩地上的房屋因不可归责于双方的火灾焚毁。合同对风险未作约定。依多数规则，损失由谁承担？
choices: The buyer — equitable conversion makes the buyer owner from signing
The seller — risk follows legal title until the deed is delivered
The parties share the loss equally
Neither — the contract is automatically rescinded
cards.explain: Equitable conversion: once a specifically enforceable contract is signed, the buyer is the equitable owner, and the majority places casualty risk on the buyer — though the seller must credit any insurance proceeds against the price. UVPRA states, including California, instead leave risk with the seller until possession or title passes.
cards.explainZh: 衡平转换：签约瞬间买方成为“衡平所有人”，风险随之转移（多数规则）；卖方已投保的，保险金须折抵价款。加州采《统一卖方买方风险法》：占有或产权移转前风险留在卖方——与《民法典》第604条交付主义异曲同工。「交付契据前风险随法定产权留在卖方」一项描述的正是少数/加州规则，在“多数规则”设问下不能选。
cards.caNote: CA Civ. Code §1662 (UVPRA): risk of loss stays with the seller until the buyer takes possession or legal title transfers.
cards.caNoteZh: 加州《民法典》§1662（UVPRA）：买方取得占有或法律产权移转之前，毁损灭失风险由卖方承担。

cards.q: Is the closing date strictly enforced in land contracts?
cards.qZh: 不动产买卖合同中的交割日期是否严格执行？
cards.a: Presumption: time is NOT of the essence — a party may perform within a reasonable time after the stated date (often up to two months), though liable for incidental delay damages. Time IS of the essence if the contract says so, circumstances show it, or a party gives reasonable advance notice — then lateness is total breach.
cards.aZh: 推定：时间并非合同要素——当事人仍可在约定日期后的合理期间内履行（法院常允许约两个月），但须赔偿迟延造成的附带损失。以下情形时间成为要素：合同明示；情势表明（市场剧烈波动、当事人另有连环交易安排）；或一方提前合理通知。此时迟延即构成完全违约。
cards.explainZh: 反直觉考点：合同写明“6月1日交割”本身≠时间是要素。与中国法“非根本违约不得解除”思维相通。一旦时间成为要素，迟到一天即丧失合同权利，衡平法也不再救济。

cards.q: Under equitable conversion, what happens if a party dies between contract and closing?
cards.qZh: 依衡平转换原则，签约与交割之间一方死亡的后果是什么？
cards.a: The buyer's interest is real property: it passes to the buyer's heirs or devisees of realty, who may compel conveyance. The seller's interest is personal property — a right to the proceeds; the seller's estate holds bare legal title in trust for the buyer, and the sale price passes as personalty.
cards.aZh: 买方的权益属不动产：由买方的继承人或不动产受遗赠人取得，可强制卖方过户。卖方的权益属动产——收取价款的权利；卖方的遗产仅为买方代持名义产权，价款作为动产分配。
cards.explainZh: 记忆图：签约那一刻双方“身份互换”——买方虽未拿到地，遗产法上已算有地之人；卖方虽名下有地，实际只剩一张收款凭证。经典考题：遗嘱写“不动产给甲、动产给乙”的人签约卖房后死亡→房子过户给买方，房款归乙。

cards.q: What are a residential seller's disclosure duties at common law and in California?
cards.qZh: 住宅卖方的披露义务：普通法与加州各如何规定？
cards.a: Majority: the seller must disclose known latent defects materially affecting value or safety; liability also lies for fraud or active concealment (painting over cracks). 'As is' clauses do not shield fraud or concealment. California adds a statutory Transfer Disclosure Statement for residential 1–4 unit sales — a detailed condition checklist that cannot be waived in ordinary sales.
cards.aZh: 多数规则：卖方须披露其明知的、实质影响价值或安全的隐蔽缺陷；欺诈或积极隐瞒（刷漆盖住裂缝）同样担责。“现状出售”条款不能豁免欺诈与隐瞒。加州另设法定《移转披露声明》（TDS），适用于1至4单元住宅买卖——详尽的房况清单，普通交易中不可放弃；经纪人负目视检查披露义务。
cards.explainZh: 普通法从“买者自慎”走向“知而不告即欺诈”。加州最严：标准化表格＋买方短期解除权。考点区分：隐蔽的白蚁结构损害（须披露）vs 一眼可见的旧屋顶（买方自查）。
cards.caNote: CA Civ. Code §1102 et seq.: TDS mandatory and non-waivable for most residential 1–4 unit sales; the buyer may rescind within 3 days of delivery (5 if mailed).
cards.caNoteZh: 加州《民法典》§1102起：TDS对多数1至4单元住宅交易强制且不可放弃；买方收到后3日内（邮寄则5日）可解除合同。

cards.q: In a sale of {{c::a new home by a builder-vendor}}, most states imply a warranty of fitness or workmanlike quality — the principal exception to caveat emptor for the quality of structures.
cards.qZh: 在____的买卖中，多数州默示适居性或工艺质量担保——这是房屋质量方面“买者自慎”原则的主要例外。
cards.a: a new home by a builder-vendor
cards.aZh: 建筑商卖方出售的新建住宅
cards.explainZh: 只保“新房＋建商卖出”：普通二手房转售不适用（部分州允许后手购房人就隐蔽缺陷直接起诉建商）。类比中国的商品房质量保修制度。加州另有《维修权法》为新住宅缺陷设定标准与诉前修复程序。
cards.caNote: California's Right to Repair Act (Civ. Code §§895–945.5) sets construction-defect standards for new residences and a mandatory pre-litigation repair process.
cards.caNoteZh: 加州《维修权法》（《民法典》§§895–945.5）为新建住宅确立缺陷标准及强制性诉前修复程序。

cards.q: Buyer closes and accepts a general warranty deed, then discovers a recorded utility easement predating the contract. Buyer sues Seller on the contract's implied promise of marketable title. Result?
cards.qZh: 买方交割并接受一般担保契据后，发现一项签约前已登记的公用事业地役权。买方依合同默示的可交易产权承诺起诉卖方。结果如何？
choices: Buyer wins — title was unmarketable at closing
Buyer wins — the easement voids the deed
Buyer may rescind the closing and recover the price
Buyer loses on the contract — it merged into the deed; the remedy lies on the deed's covenant against encumbrances
cards.explain: Under the merger doctrine, the contract's title obligations are extinguished at closing; post-closing claims lie on the deed covenants. The present covenant against encumbrances was breached at delivery, so that — not the contract — is Buyer's claim.
cards.explainZh: 并入原则：一手交钱一手交契，合同上的产权承诺随交割“寿终正寝”，此后只能依契据担保起诉。本例中现时担保之一“无负担担保”在交付时即被违反→正确的请求权基础。注意并入只吞产权事项，附随义务（如卖方承诺修屋顶）不并入。「交割时产权不可交易故买方胜」与「撤销交割并取回价款」两项用错时点：可交易产权只能在交割前主张。

cards.q: A valid deed requires a writing that identifies the parties, contains words of transfer and an adequate land description, and is signed by {{c::the grantor}} — the grantee's signature and consideration are unnecessary.
cards.qZh: 有效契据须为书面，写明当事人、含转让文句及足以确定土地的描述，并由____签署——受让人无需签字，也无需支付对价。
cards.a: the grantor
cards.aZh: 设立人／出让人（grantor）
cards.explainZh: 契据是单方处分文件：只要出让人签字。土地描述只需“合理确定”，可借助外部证据补充。对价并非必需——赠与契据完全有效（但无偿受让人不受登记法BFP保护，见rp073）。对比：合同须双方受拘束，遗嘱另有严格形式要件。

cards.q: What constitutes delivery of a deed, and what presumptions apply?
cards.qZh: 契据的“交付”指什么？适用哪些推定？
cards.a: Delivery is the grantor's present intent to pass title — shown by words or conduct; physical handover is unnecessary. Presumed delivered if recorded or in the grantee's possession; presumed not delivered if the grantor retained it. Parol evidence is admissible on intent. Once delivered, title passes — returning or destroying the deed reconveys nothing. Acceptance is presumed for beneficial grants.
cards.aZh: 交付＝设立人当下移转产权的意图——以言语或行为证明，无需实际递交文件。契据已登记或在受让人手中→推定已交付；设立人自己留存→推定未交付。交付意图可用口头证据证明。一经交付产权即告移转——把契据退回或撕毁都不能“退货”，必须重新立契。有利的赠与推定已接受。
cards.explainZh: delivery考的是意图不是快递。经典陷阱：奶奶把写好的契据锁进自己的保险箱、说“我死后归你”→无交付（保留控制＋遗嘱意图，又不符遗嘱形式→两头落空）。中国法对照：不动产变动靠登记生效；美国普通法靠交付，登记只解决对第三人的优先顺位。

cards.q: O hands a deed to his niece, saying 'this is yours only if I die during my surgery next week.' O survives and demands the deed back; the niece refuses. Who owns the land?
cards.qZh: O将契据交给侄女并说：“只有我下周手术死了，这才是你的。”O术后存活，要求返还契据；侄女拒绝。土地归谁？
choices: O — the condition failed, so there was no delivery
The niece — delivery directly to a grantee is absolute, and the oral condition is disregarded
O — the deed fails for lack of consideration
The niece — but she holds subject to divestment if O revokes in writing
cards.explain: Majority rule: an oral condition accompanying physical delivery directly TO THE GRANTEE is void — the delivery is absolute. Conditions survive only when the deed is deposited with a third-party escrow; a proper death escrow is valid, with title relating back to the deposit.
cards.explainZh: 口头条件＋直接交给受让人＝条件蒸发、交付绝对有效（多数规则）。想附条件必须走第三人提存（escrow）：把契据交给中间人、指示“我死后交付”有效，且产权回溯至存入时（避免中途死亡或失能出问题）；但设立人保留取回权的提存无交付效力。「缺乏对价故契据无效」一项错：契据无需对价。

cards.q: Name the six covenants in a general warranty deed and distinguish present from future covenants.
cards.qZh: 一般担保契据的六项担保是什么？现时担保与未来担保如何区分？
cards.a: Present: seisin (grantor owns the estate), right to convey, and against encumbrances — breached, if at all, at delivery; majority: they do not run to remote grantees. Future: quiet enjoyment, warranty (defense against lawful claims), and further assurances — breached only upon actual disturbance or eviction, and they run with the land. Damages cap: the price received.
cards.aZh: 现时担保：有权担保（seisin，确实拥有该地产权）、转让权担保、无负担担保——若违反，于交付时即成立，时效随即起算；多数州认为不随土地及于后手受让人。未来担保：安静享有担保、保护担保（抵御合法权利主张）、进一步保证担保——仅在权利实际受扰或被逐时才违反，且随土地移转。赔偿以出让人所收价款为上限。
cards.explainZh: “现时”像体检报告：交付当天照一张，问题当天定格（多数州后手告不了）；“未来”像保险单：谁被真正打扰谁索赔，随地流转。只有“合法”的第三人权利主张才触发未来担保——赶走非法侵入者是买方自己的事。

cards.q: A quitclaim deed conveys whatever interest the grantor has but contains {{c::no covenants of title}}; a special warranty deed covenants only against defects arising from the grantor's own acts.
cards.qZh: 放弃契据（quitclaim deed）转让设立人现有的任何权益，但____；特别担保契据仅对设立人自身行为造成的瑕疵作担保。
cards.a: no covenants of title
cards.aZh: 不含任何产权担保
cards.explainZh: 三档契据：一般担保（六项全保、含前手造成的瑕疵）＞特别担保（只保自己没搞鬼）＞放弃契据（裸转、什么都不保，但照样能移转完整产权）。quitclaim常用于家庭内部转让、清理产权疑云。注意：契据种类不影响买方能否成为BFP。

cards.q: What is estoppel by deed, and how can a subsequent BFP defeat it?
cards.qZh: 契据禁反言（estoppel by deed，后取产权自动归属）是什么？后来的善意买受人为何可能击败它？
cards.a: One who conveys land by warranty deed before owning it cannot deny the grantee's title: when the grantor later acquires the land, title inures automatically to the earlier grantee. But if the grantor then sells to a BFP, most courts protect the BFP — the early-recorded deed lies outside the chain of title and gives no notice.
cards.aZh: 尚未取得土地即以担保契据出让之人，不得否认受让人的产权：设立人日后取得该地时，产权自动归属于先前的受让人。但设立人若随后再卖给善意买受人，多数法院保护后者——先前那份契据登记于设立人取得产权之前，落在产权链检索范围之外，不构成通知。
cards.explainZh: 两步走：①对设立人本人，先前受让人永远赢（禁反言）；②对后手BFP，“超前登记”的契据是检索盲区——标准检索只从设立人取得产权之日查起。教训：明知卖家在“卖期货”的，等他真正取得产权后再补登记一次。

cards.q: Give the statutory language cues for race, notice, and race-notice recording acts, and California's type.
cards.qZh: 抢先登记型、通知型、抢先登记＋通知型三类登记法的法条措辞特征是什么？加州属于哪一类？
cards.a: Race: 'first recorded' language alone — first to record wins, notice irrelevant (rare). Notice: 'not valid against a subsequent purchaser for value without notice' — the later BFP wins even without recording. Race-notice: adds 'whose conveyance is first recorded' — a subsequent BFP must also record first. California is race-notice. Absent an act: common-law first in time.
cards.aZh: 抢先登记型：仅有“先登记者”字样——先登记者胜，知情与否无关（罕见：北卡、路易斯安那）。通知型：“对已支付对价且不知情的后买受人不生效力”——后来的善意买受人即使不登记也胜。抢先登记＋通知型：再加“且其转让先经登记”——后买受人须既善意又抢先登记。加州属抢先登记＋通知型。无登记法适用时回到普通法：先来先得。
cards.explainZh: 认法条抓两个短语：见'without notice'→至少是通知型；再见'first recorded'修饰后买受人→升级为race-notice。中国法对照：登记生效主义＋公信力；美国默认“先来先得”，登记法只是给善意后手的例外保护——逻辑方向相反，别搞混。
cards.caNote: CA Civ. Code §1214: an unrecorded conveyance is void as against a subsequent purchaser or mortgagee 'in good faith and for a valuable consideration, whose conveyance is first duly recorded.'
cards.caNoteZh: 加州《民法典》§1214：未登记的转让，对“善意、支付对价且其转让先经正式登记”的后买受人或抵押权人无效。

cards.q: Who qualifies as a BFP under the recording acts, and what is the shelter rule?
cards.qZh: 登记法下谁是善意买受人（BFP）？庇护规则（shelter rule）是什么？
cards.a: A purchaser or mortgagee giving substantial value — an antecedent debt alone is not value (majority) — who takes without notice: Actual, Inquiry (possession inconsistent with record; references in recorded documents), or Record. Donees, heirs, devisees, and most judgment creditors are unprotected. Shelter rule: one who takes FROM a BFP prevails even with notice — unless a prior wrongdoer repurchases.
cards.aZh: 支付实质对价的买受人或抵押权人——仅以既存债务作对价不算（多数规则）——且受让时无任何通知：实际通知、推问通知（占有状况与登记不符、登记文件中的线索）、登记通知。受赠人、继承人、受遗赠人及多数判决债权人不受保护。庇护规则：从BFP处受让者即使明知在先权利也胜——但原不法者回购除外。
cards.explainZh: BFP三件套：真买（不是白拿）、真金白银、干干净净不知情。推问通知最阴险：有人住在地上就必须去问住户什么来头！庇护规则保护的是BFP的转售价值，与中国《民法典》善意取得后权利瑕疵治愈的思路相似。判决债权人通常不算“购买人”——冷门必考。

cards.q: O deeds Blackacre to A, who does not record. O then deeds it to B, who pays value, knows nothing of A, and does not record. A then records; B records afterward. In California, who prevails?
cards.qZh: O将黑亩地让与A，A未登记。O又让与不知情、支付对价的B，B亦未登记。随后A先登记，B之后才登记。在加州，谁的产权优先？
choices: A — B, though a BFP, failed to record first
B — BFP status at the time of purchase is alone decisive
B — his later recording relates back to his purchase date
O — the double conveyance voids both deeds
cards.explain: California is race-notice: a subsequent purchaser must BOTH take without notice AND record first. B was a BFP but lost the recording race, so the statute gives him no protection and the common-law first-in-time grantee, A, prevails. In a pure notice state B would have won upon purchase.
cards.explainZh: race-notice双门槛：善意＋抢先登记，缺一不可——B输在腿慢。同一题在纯通知州答案翻转（B买入瞬间即受保护、之后登记与否不影响）——这是区分两类登记法的标准测试题。登记法帮不了的情形（后手知情或未付对价）一律回到先来先得。

cards.q: O deeds to A, who does not record. A deeds to B, who records the A-to-B deed. O then deeds to C, a BFP, who records. Who prevails?
cards.qZh: O让与A，A未登记。A让与B，B登记了A→B契据。O再让与善意买受人C，C登记。谁优先？
choices: B — he recorded before C
B — estoppel by deed protects him
C — the A-to-B deed is a wild deed outside the chain of title and gives no notice
A — first in time always prevails
cards.explain: A deed recorded without its grantor's own acquisition deed on record is a 'wild deed' — unlocatable through the grantor-grantee index — so it imparts no constructive notice and is treated as never recorded. C, a BFP who recorded a connected chain, wins even under race-notice.
cards.explainZh: 登记不是把纸塞进档案馆就完事——必须能通过“出让人—受让人索引”从O一路检索到你。O→A没登记，A→B就成了“野契据”：C按标准流程根本查不到，故不构成通知，法律上视同未登记（C仍算“先登记”者）。教训：登记前先把上游链条补全。「先来先得故A胜」一项错在登记法正是先来先得原则的例外。

cards.q: Explain lien theory versus title theory, and the relationship between the note and the mortgage.
cards.qZh: 留置权理论与产权理论有何区别？借据（note）与按揭（mortgage）是什么关系？
cards.a: The note is the personal debt; the mortgage secures it with land. Lien theory (majority, California): the mortgagee holds only a lien; the borrower keeps title and possession — one joint tenant's mortgage does not sever. Title theory: legal title sits with the mortgagee until payment. The mortgage follows the note automatically; transferring the mortgage alone is a nullity.
cards.aZh: 借据是债务本身；按揭以土地为该债务提供担保。留置权理论（多数州、加州）：贷款人仅取得担保物权，借款人保留产权与占有——因此联权共有人单独设押不切断JT。产权理论：清偿前法律产权归贷款人。借据转让时按揭自动随同移转——“担保跟着债权走”；只转按揭不转借据的行为无效。
cards.explainZh: 中国法完全对应：抵押权是从权利，随主债权转让（《民法典》第407条）——lien theory就是中国的抵押观。title theory是历史残留，实际考点只剩“是否切断联权共有”。

cards.q: How does a California deed of trust work, and what follows from nonjudicial foreclosure?
cards.qZh: 加州的信托契据（deed of trust）如何运作？非司法止赎有何法律后果？
cards.a: The borrower (trustor) conveys title to a trustee for the lender (beneficiary). On default the trustee conducts a nonjudicial power-of-sale foreclosure: recorded notice of default, three-month cure period, then roughly 21 days' notice of sale. Faster and cheaper — but NO deficiency judgment afterward and NO statutory redemption; the borrower may reinstate before the sale.
cards.aZh: 借款人（信托人）将产权转予受托人，为贷款人（受益人）持有。违约时受托人进行非司法“出售权”止赎：登记违约通知→3个月补救期→约21天的出售通知→公开拍卖。快捷省钱——但拍卖后不得再请求不足额判决，受托人出售后亦无法定赎回权；借款人可在出售前补足欠款恢复贷款。
cards.explainZh: 名为信托实为担保——受托人只是中立执行人。贷款人的抉择：走快车道（非司法）就永远放弃追讨尾款；想要不足额判决必须走法院、且借款人届时享有法定赎回权（见rp080）。加州绝大多数住房贷款用信托契据而非传统按揭。
cards.caNote: Deeds of trust with a private power of sale are the standard California security device; Civ. Code §2924 governs the nonjudicial procedure, and CCP §580d bars any deficiency after a nonjudicial sale.
cards.caNoteZh: 附私人出售权的信托契据是加州标准担保工具；《民法典》§2924规定非司法程序，《民事诉讼法典》§580d禁止非司法出售后的任何不足额判决。

cards.q: How do courts treat installment land contracts and absolute deeds given as security?
cards.qZh: 法院如何对待分期付款土地合同与“名为绝卖、实为担保”的契据？
cards.a: Installment contract: buyer possesses; seller keeps title until final payment. Forfeiture clauses are tempered by modern equity: grace periods, restitution of excess payments, or treatment as a mortgage requiring foreclosure. An absolute deed intended as security is an equitable mortgage — parol evidence admissible; the grantee must foreclose, never keep the land. Unpaid sellers retain an equitable vendor's lien.
cards.aZh: 分期付款合同：买方占有，卖方保留产权至付清尾款。没收条款（违约即丧失全部已付款并退出）历史上有效；现代衡平法给予宽限期、返还超出实际损害的已付款，或径直视同按揭而要求正式止赎。名为绝卖实为担保的契据构成衡平按揭——可用口头证据证明（清晰且有说服力标准）；“买受人”必须走止赎程序，绝不能直接吞地。未获价款的卖方另享有衡平卖方留置权。
cards.explainZh: 两个制度一个精神：实质重于形式，防止规避止赎保护。类比中国法：流押条款无效、只能优先受偿（《民法典》第401条）——美国衡平法用“当成按揭处理”达到同样效果。

cards.q: B buys Blackacre 'subject to' the existing $300k mortgage, making no promise about the loan. B defaults; foreclosure brings $250k. May the lender recover the $50k deficiency from B personally?
cards.qZh: B“带押受让”（subject to）黑亩地，未就既有的30万美元贷款作任何承诺。B断供，止赎仅拍得25万。贷款人可否向B本人追索5万差额？
choices: Yes — B assumed liability by taking possession
No — taking 'subject to' creates no personal liability; only the land secures the debt, and the original mortgagor remains liable on the note
Yes — under unjust enrichment
No — the foreclosure extinguished the entire debt
cards.explain: 'Subject to' means the land may be foreclosed but the buyer never promised to pay; any deficiency claim lies against the original mortgagor — or against an assuming grantee, who becomes primarily liable with the original mortgagor as surety. The transfer may also trigger an enforceable due-on-sale clause.
cards.explainZh: 两种带押交易：“承担”（assume）＝新主人亲自负债，原借款人退居保证人（贷款人与新主人未经其同意修改贷款条款会使原借款人相应免责）；“带押受让”＝人不负债、地照样可拍。「止赎消灭了全部债务」一项错：债务没有消灭，只是追不到B头上。另记Garn法案：“转让即到期”条款联邦法上有效（继承、夫妻间转让等除外）。在加州还要再叠一层反不足额规则（rp080）。

cards.q: Summarize California's anti-deficiency and redemption rules.
cards.qZh: 概述加州的反不足额判决规则与赎回规则。
cards.a: (1) One-action rule: the lender's single action must proceed against the security first (CCP §726). (2) No deficiency after ANY nonjudicial trustee's sale (§580d). (3) Purchase-money loans on residential 1–4 unit owner-occupied property: no deficiency ever (§580b). (4) Fair-value rules cap other deficiencies. Statutory redemption (3 months to 1 year) exists ONLY after judicial foreclosure; none after a trustee's sale.
cards.aZh: (1) 单一诉讼规则：贷款人只能提起一个诉讼，且必须先就担保物执行（《民事诉讼法典》§726）；(2) 任何非司法受托人出售之后一律不得请求不足额判决（§580d）；(3) 购房贷款＋1至4单元自住住宅：任何情形下均无不足额责任（§580b）；(4) 其余不足额受“公允价值”规则限制。法定赎回权（3个月至1年）仅存在于司法止赎之后；受托人出售后没有赎回。
cards.explainZh: 设计逻辑：保护自住购房人＋逼贷款人二选一——快（非司法）但放弃尾款 vs 慢（司法）可追偿但借款人可赎回。一句话：加州标准住宅购房贷≈无追索贷款。银行想绕过担保直接告借据？§726挡路：先动担保物，违者可能丧失担保权。
cards.caNote: The whole card is California law: §580b (purchase-money), §580d (post-trustee-sale), §726 (one action / security first). Violating §726 can forfeit the security.
cards.caNoteZh: 本卡整体即加州法：§580b（购房贷款）、§580d（非司法出售后）、§726（单一诉讼／先诉担保物）。违反§726可能导致丧失担保权。

cards.q: In 2020 Bank records a judgment lien against D reaching after-acquired realty. In 2024 D buys a home with a loan from Lender, who records its mortgage at the closing. As to the home, who has priority?
cards.qZh: 2020年银行登记了对D的判决留置权，效力及于其此后取得的不动产。2024年D以Lender的贷款购房，Lender于交割时登记按揭。就该住宅而言，谁优先？
choices: Bank — first in time, first in right
Bank — judgment liens always outrank mortgages
They share pro rata
Lender — a purchase-money mortgage takes priority over prior liens that attach through the buyer
cards.explain: A purchase-money mortgage — securing the very funds used to acquire the property and recorded promptly — beats earlier judgments, after-acquired-property clauses, and other claims arising through the purchaser: the buyer takes title already encumbered by the PMM, so the judgment lien attaches only to that encumbered title.
cards.explainZh: PMM超级优先权的逻辑：D取得产权的那一瞬间，产权“出生时就背着”PMM——判决留置权只能贴在D实际取得的（已设押的）产权上，天然排后。多个PMM并存时：卖方PMM优先于第三方贷款PMM，同类之间按登记顺序。「先设定先受偿」一项是一般规则，恰好被这个著名例外推翻。

cards.q: Blackacre carries three mortgages: Bank ($200k, first), Credit Union ($100k, second), Finance Co ($50k, third). Credit Union forecloses judicially, joining Finance Co. P buys at the sale for $180k. What results?
cards.qZh: 黑亩地上有三个按揭：银行20万（第一顺位）、信用社10万（第二顺位）、财务公司5万（第三顺位）。信用社提起司法止赎并追加财务公司为当事人。P以18万拍得。结果如何？
choices: P takes free of all three liens, and Bank is paid first from the proceeds
P takes free of Bank's lien but subject to Finance Co's
P takes subject to Bank's first mortgage; Finance Co's junior lien is wiped out; proceeds pay Credit Union, then Finance Co, any surplus to the owner
The sale is void because Bank was not joined
cards.explain: Foreclosure extinguishes the foreclosing lien and all JUNIOR interests whose holders are joined, but leaves SENIOR liens intact — the buyer takes subject to them and bids accordingly. Proceeds: costs, then the foreclosing lender, then juniors in order, then the debtor; seniors take nothing from the sale.
cards.explainZh: 铁律：止赎“向下清扫、向上无力”。P的出价＝心中估值−仍压在地上的20万优先按揭。价款瀑布：费用→止赎的信用社→更低顺位（财务公司）→剩余归业主；第一顺位银行不受影响也不分钱。未被追加的低顺位权利人其留置权存续（可自行止赎或赎回）——所以低顺位者是必要当事人，优先权人不是（「未追加银行故拍卖无效」一项错）。

cards.q: From the moment a mortgage is made, the borrower may redeem before the foreclosure sale by paying the debt; any advance waiver of this right is void as {{c::clogging the equity of redemption}}.
cards.qZh: 自按揭设立之时起，借款人在止赎拍卖前清偿债务即可赎回土地；预先放弃该权利的任何约定均因____而无效。
cards.a: clogging the equity of redemption
cards.aZh: 阻塞衡平赎回权（clogging the equity of redemption）
cards.explainZh: 衡平赎回权（拍卖前）人人有、不得在设押时放弃——与中国流押禁令神似；事后另获对价的“以地抵债”（deed in lieu of foreclosure）则有效。区分法定赎回权：拍卖后的翻盘机会，仅约半数州提供——加州只在司法止赎后有（3个月至1年），受托人出售后没有。

cards.q: State the rules on lateral and subjacent support.
cards.qZh: 侧向支撑与地下支撑的规则是什么？
cards.a: Lateral: an excavating neighbor is strictly liable if the land in its natural state would have subsided; if the weight of buildings contributed to the collapse, liability requires negligence (majority). Subjacent (severed underground rights): strict liability for the surface and structures existing when the rights were severed; negligence for later-built improvements.
cards.aZh: 侧向支撑：邻地开挖者对“处于自然状态本来就会塌陷”的土地承担严格责任；若建筑物的重量促成了塌陷，则须证明过失（多数规则）。地下支撑（地下权利分离，如采矿权）：对地表及权利分离时已存在的建筑承担严格责任；此后新建的改良适用过失标准。
cards.explainZh: 判断顺序：先问“没有房子、光是土会不会塌”——会塌→严格责任（多数州连房屋损失一并赔）；不会塌（是房子压的）→只能诉过失。与《民法典》第295条相邻挖掘安全义务同理，但美国法把严格责任与过失的分界线考得很细。

cards.q: Compare riparian, prior-appropriation, and California's hybrid water-rights systems.
cards.qZh: 河岸权制度、优先占用制度与加州的混合水权制度如何比较？
cards.a: Riparian (east): owners whose land abuts the watercourse share it; reasonable use — liability only for unreasonable interference with other riparians. Prior appropriation (west): first beneficial use in time gains priority, regardless of land location; rights are lost by abandonment. California hybrid: riparian owners hold reasonable-use rights coexisting with state-permitted appropriative rights; riparian is generally senior.
cards.aZh: 河岸权制（东部各州）：土地毗邻水道者共享水源；合理使用标准——仅在不合理妨碍其他河岸权人时担责。优先占用制（西部）：先作有益使用者取得优先顺位，与土地位置无关；抛弃使用即丧失权利。加州混合制：河岸权人享有合理使用权，与经州许可的占用水权并存；河岸权一般顺位在先。
cards.explainZh: 地理逻辑：东部水多——大家分享；西部水少——先到先得；加州两头兼收。类比：中国的取水许可制度近似appropriation的行政许可版。
cards.caNote: California: riparian rights plus a permit system for appropriations (post-1914, State Water Resources Control Board); all water use is subject to the constitutional reasonable-and-beneficial-use limit (Cal. Const. art. X, §2).
cards.caNoteZh: 加州：河岸权与占用许可制并行（1914年后的占用须经州水资源控制委员会许可）；一切用水均受州宪法“合理且有益使用”条款约束（宪法第十条第2款）。

cards.q: For diffuse surface water, the {{c::common enemy}} doctrine lets an owner repel it at will (modern courts bar unnecessary harm); the natural-flow doctrine forbids substantial alteration; most courts now apply reasonable use.
cards.qZh: 对于漫流地表水，____原则允许土地所有人任意抵御、排走（现代法院禁止造成不必要的损害）；自然流向原则禁止实质改变流向；多数法院现采合理使用标准。
cards.a: common enemy
cards.aZh: 共同敌人（common enemy）原则
cards.explainZh: 三种规则一条光谱：想怎么挡就怎么挡（common enemy）→不许改动（natural flow）→折中衡量（reasonable use，现代趋势）。顺带记空域权：土地所有人对上方空域享有合理使用范围内的权利；高空飞行不构成侵入，低飞且直接干扰使用的除外，且空域不因飞越而被时效取得。
